metadata.publication: Crime in India Annual Compendiums & Delhi Police Statistical Statements
metadata.disclaimer: Statistics reflect official First Information Reports (FIRs) registered with Delhi Police as compiled by the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB). Higher registered volumes in commercial and transit-dense districts heavily reflect mobile app and online e-FIR auto-registration for vehicle and property theft, rather than higher localized physical danger. Zero published incidents in an area does not indicate the absence of crime. Individual incident addresses are not published to safeguard citizen privacy and prevent defamatory property profiling.
